questions.question: The headquarters of the United Nations is in:
questions.explanation: The UN headquarters is in New York City.

questions.question: The "fiscal deficit" is the difference between:

options.B: Total expenditure and total receipts excluding borrowings

questions.explanation: Fiscal deficit = total expenditure − total receipts (excluding borrowings).

questions.question: The Khajuraho temples were built by which dynasty?
questions.explanation: The Chandela dynasty built the Khajuraho temples.

questions.question: The Preamble of the Indian Constitution was inspired by the Constitution of:
questions.explanation: The idea of a Preamble was borrowed from the US Constitution.

questions.question: The SI unit of force is:
questions.explanation: Force is measured in newtons (N).

questions.question: The instrument used to measure atmospheric pressure is the:
questions.explanation: A barometer measures atmospheric pressure.

questions.question: Which part of the plant conducts photosynthesis using the green pigment?
questions.explanation: Chlorophyll is the green pigment that captures light energy.

questions.question: Who founded the Arya Samaj?
questions.explanation: Swami Dayananda Saraswati founded the Arya Samaj in 1875.

questions.question: How many schedules are there in the Indian Constitution?
questions.explanation: The Constitution currently has 12 schedules.

questions.question: Who was the first President of India?
questions.explanation: Dr. Rajendra Prasad served as the first President (1950–62).

questions.question: Which day is celebrated as International Yoga Day?
questions.explanation: International Yoga Day is 21 June.

questions.question: Which tax was subsumed under GST?
questions.explanation: Service Tax (among others) was subsumed under GST.

questions.question: Which gas is most abundant in the Earth’s atmosphere?
questions.explanation: Nitrogen is about 78% of the atmosphere.

questions.question: The deficiency of which vitamin causes scurvy?
questions.explanation: Scurvy is caused by a deficiency of Vitamin C.

questions.question: The concept of "Directive Principles of State Policy" was borrowed from which country?
questions.explanation: The Directive Principles were borrowed from the Irish Constitution.

questions.question: In which sport is the term "googly" used?
questions.explanation: A "googly" is a type of delivery in cricket.

questions.question: Light travels fastest in:
questions.explanation: Light travels fastest in a vacuum (~3×10⁸ m/s).

questions.question: The Nobel Prize is NOT awarded in which field?
questions.explanation: There is no Nobel Prize in Mathematics.

questions.question: Which is the southernmost point of mainland India?
questions.explanation: Kanyakumari is the southernmost point of mainland India (Indira Point is the southernmost of Indian territory).

questions.question: The process by which plants lose water through leaves is called:
questions.explanation: Transpiration is the loss of water vapour from leaves.

questions.question: What is 20% of 220?
Find the simple interest on ₹2800 at 5% per annum for 3 years.
Find the compound interest on ₹8000 at 5% per annum for 2 years.
An article costing ₹1000 is sold for ₹1200. Find the profit percentage.
An article costing ₹840 is sold at a 10% profit. Find the selling price.
Find the average of the first five multiples of 2.
questions.explanation: Multiples: 2, 4, 6, 8, 10. Sum = 30. Average = 30/5 = 6.

questions.question: Two numbers are in the ratio 3 : 4 and their sum is 84. Find the larger number.
questions.explanation: Total parts = 7. Each part = 84/7 = 12. Larger = 4 × 12 = 48.

questions.question: A train 150 m long crosses a pole in 6 seconds. Find its speed in km/h.
A can do a work in 12 days and B in 24 days. Working together, in how many days will they finish it?
questions.explanation: Combined one-day work = 1/12 + 1/24 = 36/288. Time = 288/36 = 8 days.

questions.question: Find the area of a circle with radius 21 cm. (Use π = 22/7)
Find the value of √1444.
After a 10% discount, an item costs ₹450. Find its marked price.
Find 20% of 50% of 200.
Two numbers are in the ratio 5 : 7 and their difference is 18. Find the smaller number.
questions.explanation: Difference = 2 parts = 18, so each part = 9. Smaller = 5 × 9 = 45.

questions.question: A boat travels 30 km downstream in 3 hours. If the speed of the stream is 2 km/h, find the speed of the boat in still water.
questions.explanation: Downstream speed = 30/3 = 10 km/h = boat + stream. Boat = 10 − 2 = 8 km/h.

questions.question: If today is Friday, what day will it be after 84 days?
questions.explanation: 84 mod 7 = 0; Friday + 0 = Friday.

questions.question: Which letter is 6th to the right of the 14th letter from the left in the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: 14th letter = N; 14 + 6 = 20th letter = T.

questions.question: Find the odd pair: (8, 512), (7, 343), (3, 29), (5, 125)
questions.explanation: In each correct pair the second number is the cube of the first. 3³ = 27, not 29.

questions.question: In a row of 43 students, Ravi is 12th from the left. What is his position from the right?
questions.explanation: Position from right = 43 − 12 + 1 = 32.

questions.question: Find the next term: 25, 36, 49, 64, 81, ?
questions.explanation: These are perfect squares 5²…9². Next is 10² = 100.

questions.question: Find the next term: 3, 8, 15, 24, 35, ?
questions.explanation: Differences increase by 2 each step; next difference is 13, so 35 + 13 = 48.

questions.question: If TREE is coded as XVII, how is BIRD coded?
questions.explanation: Each letter is shifted forward by 4. Applying the same to BIRD gives FMVH.

questions.question: What is the angle between the hour and minute hands of a clock at 4:00?
questions.explanation: Each hour mark = 30°. At 4:00 the angle is 4 × 30° = 120°.
The relation is squaring: 6² = 36, so 7² = 49.

questions.question: A person walks 9 km East and then 12 km North. What is the shortest distance from the starting point?
questions.explanation: Shortest distance = √(9² + 12²) = √225 = 15 km.

questions.question: If + means ×, and × means −, then evaluate: 9 + 5 × 5.
questions.explanation: Replace symbols: 9 × 5 − 5 = 45 − 5 = 40.

questions.question: Find the next term: 4, 8, 16, 32, ?
questions.explanation: Each term follows ×2: 32 × 2 = 64.

questions.question: Complete the series: B, E, H, K, ?
questions.explanation: Each letter advances by 3 places, so the next is N.

questions.question: Find the odd one out: 22, 31, 19, 2
questions.explanation: 19, 2, 31 are prime numbers; 22 is a composite number.

questions.question: Which letter is 11th from the right end of the English alphabet?
questions.explanation: The 11th letter from the right is the 16th from the left = P.
